decisions.reason: The piqué upholstery fabric is close to the core offer, still has its own web page, and costs little to carry, so after two years the option stays open while contract demand plays out.
The bouclé-effect sheer has only a brief mention online, which signals weaker traction, but production partners make carrying it cheap, so it stays for one more season before a firmer judgment.
The flame-retardant jacquard serves hospitality and contract projects with long specification cycles, so its value is still unfolding and holding it costs little.
The wool bouclé leno fits the shift toward renewable materials and is cheap to keep, though its limited online visibility raises the chance it is pruned at the next collection review.
The braided-structure fabric launched only in 2024 and has its own page, so its uncertainty is far from resolved and the option should clearly stay open.
